english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for someone travelling for pleasure.
Use this for a sightseer or tourist visiting a place, especially as part of a trip.

examples.english: This tourist came to Hong Kong to take photos.
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 jau4 haak3 lei4 hoeng1 gong2 jing2 soeng2

examples.english: A visitor is taking photos here.
examples.jyutping: jau5 wai2 jau4 haak3 hai2 dou6 jing2 gan2 soeng2
